purpose: Adapter addition for strict nineteenth-century NMS accession evidence; existing Science Museum Group and Whipple adapters are reused.
guards: Treat museum accession subpoints as item identities only when the source explicitly documents the parent box/set relationship.
Do not infer slide makers or specimen subjects where the curatorial source only establishes count, date and accession hierarchy.

adapters.institution_scope: National Museums Scotland Science and Technology collections
adapters.target: museum-authored curatorial research describing extant collection database records
adapters.promotion_rule: Capture exact parent/subpoint accession structure, stated count and date; seek a current NMS catalogue endpoint before enriching maker/specimen-level fields.
